name: Enemy Posture System PRIVATE TEST
author: Dusklight community mods
description: PRIVATE TEST. Enemy Posture System 0.7.0. Below posture 100 a confirmed non-lethal hit never staggers a Bokoblin. The hit that reaches 100 breaks the posture: native shield stun, then a short window where a decisive sword/Helm contact deals x1.50 once and knocks it down natively; on the ground the native Finish is available; after the native get-up the posture rearms to 0 (also when another AI mod redirects the get-up exit). A thin posture bar under the enemy's life bar (display only) grows from the centre to both ends in gold, amber, orange and red, pulses once when the posture breaks and retracts while it recovers. Works without Enemy Health Bars. Replaces 0.6.1 and older versions of this mod (same ID): never load them together. Human Windows DX12 validation pending.
